title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if the columns are linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others.

title: Checking for Linear Combinations
text: Check if the new columns (height in inches and weight in pounds) can be expressed as linear combinations of the original columns (height in cm, weight in kg, and BMI).

title: Conversion Formulas
text: Remember the conversion formulas: height (in) $$=$$ height (cm) / $$2.54$$ and weight (lb) $$=$$ weight (kg) * $$2.2$$. Use these to check for linear dependence.

title: Conclusion on Linear Independence
text: Since height (in) and weight (lb) can be expressed as linear combinations of height (cm) and weight (kg), the columns are not linearly independent.

title: Span of the Columns
text: The span of the columns of humans is the same as the span of the original columns because the new columns are linear combinations of the original ones.
